subject: Re: NexaHealth: residency surcharge + HSM - proposed blended credit path
messages:
From: Elizabeth Hart <elizabeth@nexahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@nredwood.com>
Cc: purchasing@nexahealth.com
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Residency surcharge + HSM licensing questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the pricing deck from last week. Our procurement team is reviewing the residency and HSM line items and asked for a couple clarifications before we can issue a PO: 

- Can you confirm whether the residency surcharge can be amortized as an implementation fee (one-time) vs. recurring monthly? Our finance prefers CAPEX vs OPEX.
- If we provide our own HSM (FIPS 140-2 validated, vendor: CryptoBox) and host in our VPC, is Redwood able to remove the HSM seat charge or apply a larger credit?
- Any written milestone schedule you can put on the PO for delivery / activation so our SOW and accounting teams can align?

We're trying to avoid a multi-line negotiation with legal/finance in parallel — a single PO with clear milestones and a pilot credit would be ideal. Attaching our standard PO template for reference (purchasing@nexahealth.com will follow up).

Appreciate a short response we can hand to finance.

Best,
Elizabeth
VP Product, NexaHealth

Attachment: Nexa_PO_v1.pdf (PDF, 76KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@nredwood.com>
To: Elizabeth Hart <elizabeth@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@nredwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@nredwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Residency surcharge + HSM licensing questions

Hi Elizabeth — thanks for the clear ask and the PO template. Quick answers up front, details below so procurement can copy into the PO: 

1) Amortization: we can structure the residency surcharge as a one-time implementation charge amortized over 12 months in your invoices (vs an ongoing surcharge). That shows up as a one-time line item on the commitment invoice and then we reflect the credit monthly as negative recurring until the amortization completes.

2) BYOHSM: We support customer-managed HSMs but need an integration and attestation window. If you provide a validated HSM and our security review is satisfied, we can offer a 60-75% offset to the HSM seat charge (amount depends on attestation and connectivity model).

3) Milestones: proposed minimal milestone set for PO: 
   - M1: Contract execution / PO received (invoice 30% implementation)
   - M2: HSM attestation & connectivity test (activation window)
   - M3: Production cutover & residency validation (final 20% of implementation)

I'm looping Ben to comment on discounting and legal/payment terms, and Mina to confirm integration timing and any constraints for BYOHSM.

— Priyom
Principal Sales 
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@nredwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@nredwood.com>
Cc: Elizabeth Hart <elizabeth@nexahealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@nredwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Residency surcharge + HSM licensing questions

Thanks Priyom — good summary. Elizabeth, quick commercial proposal to make this procurement-friendly: 

- Pilot credit: 50% credit on first 3 months of residency surcharge (applied as a credit note against invoice) so you can run verification without a full recurring hit.
- Implementation amortization: we will invoice the full implementation/residency amount up front to comply with our internal revenue recognition, but we can provide a customer-facing amortization schedule on the PO per your accounting needs (12-months suggested).
- BYOHSM concession: contingent 65% offset to the HSM seat charge on successful attestation + connectivity test. If attestation extends beyond 30 days, offset reduces by 10% per additional 15-day period (to account for extended engineering support).
- Payment terms: standard net-45 for first invoice; we can accept PO + DocuSign signature.

If that looks OK to you, we'll prepare a one-page commercial summary and a DocuSign for signature. I'll also include the deal id NX-2028-0142 so your procurement can reference it.

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-142

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@nredwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@nredwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@nredwood.com>, Elizabeth Hart <elizabeth@nexahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Feb 2028 13:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Residency surcharge + HSM licensing questions — technical notes

Hi all — technical constraints to call out for the PO and milestone language: 

- BYOHSM is supported but we require: 
  * FIPS 140-2 or 140-3 certification report (pdf)
  * Network connectivity: VPN + mTLS; expected onboarding engineering effort: 2-4 engineer-days for validation and cert exchange.
  * Operational SLA: if you host the HSM, we need an on-call contact and a pre-agreed maintenance window.

- Integration timeline: 
  * Window A (standard): 10 business days from attestation materials + test credentials.
  * Window B (complex environments): up to 30 business days (e.g., restricted networking or air-gapped) — we should avoid this for pilot or else pilot credit timelines will shift.

- Suggested PO wording to avoid rework: "Redwood will apply BYOHSM credit upon successful completion of connectivity test and attestation as documented in Schedule A. Connectivity test must be scheduled within 30 days of contract execution."

Attaching an internal note that outlines the checklist and typical work breakdown so procurement can see why we have the timelines.

Attachment: HSM_integration_notes.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

— Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer
